clues.text: At Shiloh, this priest watched Hannah's lips move in silent prayer and thought she was drunk.
Three times in one night, the boy Samuel ran to this old priest, thinking he had been called.
This priest told young Samuel to answer, 'Speak, LORD, for Your servant is listening.'
His two sons were wicked priests who treated the LORD's offering with contempt.
Hearing that the ark of God was captured, this old priest fell backward from his chair and broke his neck.
A man of God warned this priest that his sons Hophni and Phinehas would both die on the same day.
Dying in childbirth, this priest's daughter-in-law named her son Ichabod, saying the glory had departed.
